{"code": "# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH and completed orders
filtered_df = sales_df[
    (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of new customers who converted
num_converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()
total_new_paid_search = len(filtered_df)
conversion_rate = num_converted / total_new_paid_search

print(f"Number of new paid search customers (completed): {total_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Number who converted: {num_converted}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
